alt: Hematopoiesis flow chart: a multipotential hematopoietic stem cell (hemocytoblast) dividing into a common myeloid progenitor - giving megakaryocyte and thrombocytes, erythrocyte, mast cell, and myeloblast leading to basophil, neutrophil, eosinophil and monocyte/macrophage - and a common lymphoid progenitor giving the natural killer cell and the small lymphocyte, which becomes the T lymphocyte or the B lymphocyte and then the plasma cell.
